source: Haw et al. 2025 (first author Nel Jason Haw), J Int AIDS Soc 28:e26526, Supporting Information JIA2-28-e26526-s001.docx, Supplementary Table 1 only
methods_text: PubMed, EMBASE and African Index Medicus searched for peer-reviewed articles searchable using English keywords published 1 January 2010 to 1 June 2023; bibliographies of selected articles hand-searched; conference abstracts excluded at screening.
combination_note: Note: Each set of search terms (“concept”) was stitched together as follows: [HIV] AND [Children and adolescents] AND ([HIV care continuum] or [Diagnosis] or [Antiretroviral therapy] or [Linkage to care] or [Retention in care] or [Viral load testing] or [Adherence]) AND [Countries in Eastern and Southern Africa] AND [Publication from 2010]
